rationale.hypothesis: Raw listing of neighboring reports causes Jev to over-weight dramatic life-safety reports from adjacent blocks (e.g., 911 STRUCTURE-COLLAPSE, WATER-RESCUE, fire-dept Destroyed), bleeding life-safety states onto intact or less-damaged blocks. This drives both false dispatches and misclassifications like roof_damage→collapsed. Summarizing neighbors as a profile should reduce this bleeding while preserving useful context.
rationale.refuted_if: False dispatches don't decrease or life-safety found drops below 215, showing Jev needs raw neighbor listings to correctly identify true life-safety blocks.

prediction: False dispatches should drop below 80 and intact accuracy should improve. Life-safety found may decrease slightly but should stay above 220. Balanced accuracy should increase to ~62-63%.
